note: Haralson County and its cities (Bremen, Buchanan, Tallapoosa, Waco) publish zoning only as static PDF or JPG maps (county Zoning Map; Bremen zoning map PDF; Tallapoosa JPG from NWGRC). Buchanan's district map is kept on file with the City Clerk, not published. Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online within the county box and the state, plus county, NWGRC and GIO hub searches, found no queryable zoning district polygon layer. Only third-party sites (zoneomics, parcel vendors) show zoning, and they are not official services.
